source: JGLUE JNLI v1.3（Yahoo Japan, CC BY-SA 4.0）の validation から各ラベル 100 件

metric_definitions.label: accuracy (all)
metric_definitions.basis: plain choice reading: selected option with highest probability (default rule); correct / labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: macro-F1
metric_definitions.basis: plain choice reading: selected option with highest probability (default rule); mean of per-class F1 over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: AUROC
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; macro one-v-rest AUROC over options and labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: Brier score
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; multiclass Brier score over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: ECE
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; calibration of selected-answer correctness over labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accuracy (all)
metric_definitions.basis: configured tiebreak objective; primary CV chosen rule; denominator: labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: coverage (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed accepted / labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accepted accuracy (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed correct accepted / accepted labelled dev cases

notices: development cases only; the held-out test share was not scored or exposed in this comparison
constraints are reference metadata; this comparison does not filter or select candidates
latency not compared (1 with no concurrency recorded): measure every candidate again at one concurrency, s1flow run jnli-support --fresh --concurrency N (the same N for all)
4 candidates have missing or ineligible evidence; see each candidate's excluded reasons
